title: Lampmaster - Act 1 Boss Guide (Location, Weakness & How to Beat)
description: Lampmaster in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it. Act 1, Stone Wave Cliffs.

facts.label: Key Drops
facts.value: Colour of Lumina · Grandiose Chroma Catalyst

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Lampmaster is the final boss of Act 1 and the game's first genuine difficulty spike. It has no elemental weakness at all, so you cannot build your way around it - the fight is decided by handling its lamp mechanic and its Dizzy debuff.

sections.title: Where to Find the Lampmaster
sections.content: Location: Stone Wave Cliffs, at the end of Act 1. This is the last mandatory fight before the story moves into Act 2, so clear your side content first.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toNone
ResistsLight

There is no weakness to exploit and Light is resisted, so avoid leaning on Light skills. This is the first boss where raw execution beats build theory.

sections.title: How to Beat the Lampmaster
sections.content:
Lampmaster hovers and shoots lamps, and the fight is a targeting puzzle before it is a damage race.

Shoot the lamps

The lamps are separate targets. Destroying them removes the attacks tied to them, which shrinks its move list as the fight goes on. Ignore them and you spend the whole fight dodging a wider and wider spread.

Dizzy

Lampmaster can inflict Dizzy, which wobbles your camera and makes free aim unreliable. If you depend on free aim to hit weak points, this debuff will cost you turns - plan to use skill-based damage during those windows instead.

  • No element works: bring your highest raw damage line.
  • Spend early turns killing lamps rather than racing the health bar.
  • Light is resisted - do not build around it.
